# Hill climb progress: set up on 2026-11-02

The hill climb is running on this ad account. Its number is the cost of a conversion on the platform's count; history's
best ad, a question over the app's screen with a free week, ran at about $1.39 per conversion in October.

- Money: $600 to spend, at about $45 a day.
- Live: history's best ad keeps earning, and two explore tests try a claim hook and a hand replay beside it on the same
  days; both read on 2026-11-05.
- Learned so far: nothing yet. The first reads come on 2026-11-05.
- Exploring: 2 of the 9 hook and visual combinations are being tried; the competitors' ads that run longest, a coach
  telling a story on camera, come next.

The next report goes out on 2026-11-09.
